inputs.name: net_interest_paid
inputs.provenance: HAND, 2026-10-28 (E141 decision). DHI_FY2025_annual-report-10k_2025-11-19_en_a0.htm (10-K 0000882184-25-000081 filed 2025-11-19), Note E inventory interest table, year ended September 30: 'Interest incurred (1) 241.7 203.7 203.5' (2025, 2024, 2023, in millions), footnote (1): 'includes interest on the Company's mortgage repurchase facilities of $ 33.9 million, $ 58.6 million and $ 45.9 million'. This filer prints NO interest paid: 'the Company's active inventory exceeded its debt level, and all interest incurred was capitalized to inventory', so the cash interest leaves through inventory inside operating activities (ASC 230) and is never a separate line. Entered: interest incurred 241.7 LESS the mortgage repurchase facility's 33.9 = 207.8 million. The repurchase facility funds mortgage loans held for sale and its interest is the mortgage operation's own cost of goods, earned back in its interest income; its debt STAYS in net debt (notes payable as printed), so leaving its interest in the flow errs low on both sides. Interest received is not stated apart from 'Other income'; nothing is netted, and the add-back is the cost side only.
